title: Critical Boundaries of Quadratic Polylogarithm Feedback
status: Unrefereed conventional proofs; not externally refereed, not Lean-formalized, not interval-certified.
global_priority: Not established; source overlap audit is explicitly scoped.

theorems.label: qb:thm:summary
theorems.title: Fixed-parameter boundary classification
theorems.contribution_scope: Completes the explicitly pending quadratic boundary problem.

theorems.label: qb:prop:coeff
theorems.title: Exact coefficient descriptions
theorems.dependencies: Quadratic lift and classical Lagrange inversion
theorems.contribution_scope: Lift identity and recurrence; the positive finite formula is credited to the predecessor.

theorems.label: qb:prop:global
theorems.title: Global disk and strict-circle continuation
theorems.dependencies: Positive coefficients, monotone iteration, analytic implicit function theorem
theorems.contribution_scope: Provides the missing complex-dominance step for the boundary regime.

theorems.label: qb:lem:transfer
theorems.title: Polylogarithmic transfer coordinates
theorems.dependencies: Classical Gamma–zeta expansion and finite singularity transfer
theorems.contribution_scope: Model-independent classical mechanism; used as an exact bookkeeping dictionary, not claimed new.

theorems.label: qb:thm:strict
theorems.title: Strict boundary law with integer orders

theorems.label: qb:thm:hahn
theorems.title: Lower critical convergent Hahn chart
theorems.dependencies: Exact master equation, analytic two-variable implicit function theorem
theorems.contribution_scope: Explicit quadratic specialization; analogous linear-core mechanisms are credited.

theorems.label: qb:lem:finite-chart
theorems.title: Finite bivariate coefficient recipe
theorems.dependencies: Ordinary Lagrange inversion with an auxiliary multiplier
theorems.contribution_scope: General inversion tool, not claimed to be a new Lagrange theorem.

theorems.label: qb:cor:hahn-transfer
theorems.title: Every fixed coefficient-asymptotic order
theorems.contribution_scope: Convergent local chart is distinguished from a finite-order coefficient asymptotic expansion.

theorems.label: qb:cor:fivehalves
theorems.title: Missing n^(-2) term at s=5/2
theorems.dependencies: Explicit chart coefficients and reciprocal-Gamma zero
theorems.contribution_scope: Model-specific explicit cancellation and second nonzero coefficient.

theorems.label: qb:thm:Lambert
theorems.title: Exactly normalized marginal Lambert core
theorems.dependencies: Integer polylogarithm expansion and Rouche perturbation

theorems.label: qb:thm:log-all
theorems.title: All inverse-logarithmic coefficient corrections
theorems.dependencies: Lambert finite reversion, reciprocal-Gamma Hankel moments
theorems.contribution_scope: Explicit finite coefficient compiler and first two corrections.

theorems.label: qb:thm:upper-chart
theorems.title: Upper critical noninteger Hahn chart
theorems.dependencies: Exact master equation, analytic implicit function theorem
theorems.contribution_scope: Explicit quadratic chart and minimum ramification index.

theorems.label: qb:thm:integer-obstruction
theorems.title: Integer logarithmic obstruction to Puiseux structure
theorems.dependencies: Pole-cancelled expansion, perturbed analytic square-root core
theorems.contribution_scope: Nonzero first logarithm at every integer m>=4.

theorems.label: qb:cor:four
theorems.title: Nonzero n^(-2) term at s=4
theorems.contribution_scope: Explicit positive correction distinguishes square-root leading behavior from a Puiseux germ.

theorems.label: qb:thm:prefix
theorems.title: Finite-prefix/amplitude extension
theorems.dependencies: Same positivity proof and exact moment substitutions
theorems.contribution_scope: Tracks the quadratic contribution in the marginal normalization.

finite_evidence.evidence_status: Exact finite checks plus non-certified floating-point diagnostics; not Lean or interval verification.

exact.scope: Rational comparisons through n=10; Lambert/Hankel polynomials through degree 4; stated finite local identities.

local.scope: Floating-point identities, not interval or global-continuation certificates.

coefficients.scope: Positive recurrence in floating-point arithmetic; asymptotic ratios are diagnostics, not proofs.

not_claimed: Uniform u->U_c(s) or s->3 coefficient transitions
